## Contribution Idea

Describe the small improvement, docs update, template, test, or example.

## Why It Helps

Explain how this improves AIReleaseKit for AI product managers, engineers, or contributors.

## Suggested Files

- `docs/`
- `examples/`
- `tests/`
- `packages/core/src/generate/`
- Other:

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The change is small and focused.
- [ ] It includes docs or tests when appropriate.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] It does not require proprietary data or API keys.

## Notes for Contributors

Ask questions in the issue if the scope is unclear. Small, readable improvements are welcome.
